title: CPRD, unseen-highway split

data.validation: 20% of TRAIN, StratifiedGroupKFold(5) by group, seed 42; test never used for selection

recipe.augmentation: Resize 224, HFlip, Rotation 10, ColorJitter(0.15, 0.15) (batched on GPU)

timing_note: train_time_s = wall time of the training loop incl. per-epoch validation (GPU, AMP); the GPU and CPU were shared with the QNN experiments during training, so train times are indicative only. Inference was re-measured on 2026-11-04 14:47:21 with the machine otherwise idle (`--bench-only`): model forward pass only (no image decoding/resizing), fp32, eval mode, batch 1 as in the API (bs 64 = per-image time inside a batch of 64); median over 5 interleaved rounds of 60 CPU / 100 GPU runs, 8 CPU threads. Speed depends only on the architecture, so the same numbers are reported for both split variants.
